function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate how, if at all, the Lazarus Group and the intrusion set commonly called APT38 can be linked to the Ronin Bridge cryptocurrency theft and the Harmony Horizon cryptocurrency theft, with a strict evidence hierarchy. Use only evidence and source IDs returned by the benchmark tools; do not invent facts, wallet addresses, entity names, relationship labels, or citations. Collect and report: (1) public attribution statements by governments, law-enforcement agencies, cybersecurity companies, blockchain investigators, exchanges, bridge operators, and other relevant sources, quoting or accurately paraphrasing the attribution and labeling each as confirmed official attribution, public allegation, analytic assessment, or unresolved/contested; (2) similarities and differences in laundering and cash-out methods, including transaction flows, intermediary services, bridges, mixers, exchanges, asset conversions, timing, and obfuscation techniques; and (3) wallet and blockchain evidence, including only source-supported wallet addresses, fund movements, behavioral patterns, and relationships among entities. Explicitly distinguish what is directly observed on-chain from what is inferred, identify contradictions between sources, and state uncertainty. Cover dates and developments up to October 1, 2026 if the returned sources support them. Return a structured evidence dossier with source IDs attached to every material statement, a chronology for each theft, a comparison table, an evidence-grade assessment of the possible linkage, and precise guidance for a final Markdown report ending in a fenced JSON object with arrays named findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions. Ensure every JSON item can be traced only to returned source IDs."}
function.name: ConductResearch
